title: Common Geodesics Do Not Guarantee Fisher Consistency of the Structured SVM: Minimal Counterexamples and a Tree-Metric Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.27203v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A known necessary condition for Fisher consistency of the structured support vector machine requires the task loss to be a metric for which every output triple has a common geodesic point. We show that this condition is not sufficient for the canonical coordinate-wise argmax decoder. A four-output unit star admits an exactly optimal score vector whose maximizers are all strictly non-Bayes, and four outputs are minimal among metrics satisfying the condition. We then completely classify positively weighted tree metrics whose vertex set is the output space: argmax consistency holds if and only if the tree is a path. The failure on branching trees is confined to boundary distributions; every tree retains the argmax property at every full-support distribution. translated_title: 公共测地线不保证结构化SVM的Fisher一致性：最小反例与树度量分类
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27203v1 公告类型：新 摘要：结构化支持向量机Fisher一致性的一个已知必要条件是任务损失函数必须是一个度量，且每个输出三元组都有一个公共测地线点。我们证明了这个条件对于标准的坐标逐点argmax解码器并不充分。一个四输出的单位星形结构允许一个精确最优的得分向量，其所有最大化的输出都严格非贝叶斯，而在满足该条件的度量中，四输出是最小的。然后我们完全分类了输出空间为顶点集的正加权树度量：argmax一致性成立当且仅当树是一条路径。在分支树上的失败仅限于边界分布；每棵树在满支撑分布下都保持argmax性质。在满足公共测地线条件的度量中，五个输出是满支撑反例的充分必要条件；$K_{2,3}$是无限$K$族中最小的成员。
tldr: 本文发现公共测地线条件并非结构化SVM Fisher一致性的充分条件，并完全分类了树度量下的argmax一致性，指出仅路径树满足，分支树仅边界分布失败。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the common-geodesic condition is insufficient for Fisher consistency of structured SVM, and fully classifies tree metrics where argmax consistency holds only for paths, with failures confined to boundary distributions.
